subject.title: fix(agents): resolve legacy modelstudio profile aliases

question: Should legacy `modelstudio:*` selectors be migrated by the Qwen plugin/Doctor while preserving custom `modelstudio` provider ownership, rather than supported by a global runtime auth alias?
rationale: The repository policy requires canonical runtime configuration and owner-scoped migration, while the proposed global alias conflicts with a documented custom-provider use case. Selecting the durable compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use owner-scoped migration
options.body: Restore the files and migrate legacy Qwen-owned selectors through the Qwen plugin or Doctor, leaving custom `modelstudio` providers independent.

options.title: Adopt global auth aliasing
options.body: Explicitly accept `modelstudio` as a global Qwen auth alias and define how custom providers avoid credential redirection.

options.title: Pause this compatibility path
options.body: Close or defer the runtime compatibility change until the legacy persisted-state contract is documented and reproducible.

recommendation.title: Use owner-scoped migration
recommendation.body: Restore the files and migrate legacy Qwen-owned selectors through the Qwen plugin or Doctor, leaving custom `modelstudio` providers independent.
